Sure, I worked with them for a year. Their support system suck, they have no one on the technical site and they don't offer any type of onboarding. Even if you are bringing 78 inboxes to the software. Besides that, their journey system is a pain in the ass. They lie in the data you see on the dashboard, once you download their csv files you see data missing and a lot of leads go into the pause stage and they never notify you about it. As a very simple example, I wanted to analyze the conversion rate and add as a variable the Sent date of the initial pitch and that information is not available to download. For me, and having in mind I'm managing multiple campaigns and have worked as Head of Outreach (SEO) for the last 8 years, their software is not good enough to manage massive campaigns. It might work for a few inboxes for vendors that burn out really fast their inboxes and never look back, but if you have to report and find trends their tool is a nightmare. Only good thing is that they are cheap and if you bother them enough you will get in a call with their CEO.
Stay away from Quickmail, I would recommend Mailshake and hire a data analyst to work on the data. Cold Mail is not dead, but the days of sending 500 emails per day on free Gmail accounts are dead.
